name: bendit-drive
description: bendit's browser driver (drive.mjs). Playwright is NOT a dependency here: scripts/drive-setup.sh installs exactly playwrightVersion into the user's cache, never into a project. playwrightVersion is the latest stable release on npm on playwrightChosenOn; engines.node is that release's own engines.node, and install.sh's NODE_MIN is its major (drive.test.sh checks both).
